units: authored world units scaled 2x at build; bike calibration required

compositionRules.coins: Allocate purposeful stunt/flight clusters first; sparse orientation coins only after highlight budgets; preserve readable spacing and clear recovery
compositionRules.cinematicObjects: Every spring, explosive connector, barrel or boost must name the beat it serves, its launch/commitment purpose, landing or fallback and recovery; never scatter randomly or boost immediately before a velocity-replacing spring
compositionRules.explosiveRoute: Ride the active pre-route, detonate only after rear-wheel commitment, reveal a deterministic forward route with immediate collision, keep debris visual-only, then provide stable recovery
compositionRules.difficulty: teach, practice, combine within a difficulty band
compositionRules.checkpoint: first stable pad after hard gap; keep finish distance max(8 units,8% length)
compositionRules.geometry: local cubic Bezier; closed ground; open auxiliary ramps
compositionRules.spring: Each spring_high/spring_far family: first 5 variants have separated ground platforms with a deadzone in the gap; last 5 have connected ground platforms and no deadzone. Floating spring catches retain a lower tunnel and uphill recovery.
compositionRules.joins: position and travel tangent must match; check speed compatibility
compositionRules.validation: geometry verified separately from bike simulation
